title: K — #20 seventy-one one-shot probe scripts archived, guards landed first
paragraphs: Repo hygiene, no user-visible feature. Seventy-one measurement scripts that each ran once and then only pretended to guard anything have moved to docs/archive/probes, and BEFORE any moved, every claim they held either became a real unit test that runs on every pnpm test (47 new tests, 15/15 mutants die) or was written into the archive with its numbers.

The one assertion that changed is a census floor (probes present > 60 became > 40), because a floor of 60 could only be met by keeping dead probes. Every other assertion is untouched and the gate is green.
checks: This tab loads and you can type; nothing user-visible changed, so a working editor is the check.
In the repo, git log c9563cf..6d751bd shows the guard commits landing before the move commit.
Change MAX_PER_FRAME = 1 to 2 in SnapshotView.tsx and run the snapshotScrubDriver test: it goes red, which nothing in the repo did yesterday.
